name: clear-transcript
description: Experimental. How the conversation is drawn inside stock Claude Code: headings in an answer get a hierarchy, and a settled tool group names its files and commands and shows which of them failed, instead of a bare count. Presentation only: no word the model wrote is removed, reordered or added, ctrl+o shows every row as Claude Code draws it, and /clear-transcript off does the same in place. Built on function hooks (Claude Mods), which are early access: it loads only where they are enabled and may break on any Claude Code release. The transcript layer of Clear Claude; independent of Clear Partner and Clear UI.

headings.title: Heading hierarchy in answers
headings.description: Draw the headings of an answer as a hierarchy. Off: every answer is drawn by Claude Code.

toolGroups.title: Named tool groups
toolGroups.description: A finished group of reads, searches and commands names its targets and shows failures. Off: every group is drawn by Claude Code.
